items.title: Gold price set for steep weekly loss as rising oil prices bolster Fed rate hike bets
items.summary: Spot gold slipped below $4,000 to $3,998.35 on Friday and was down about 4% for the week, its worst since June. Brent at a five-month high after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia raised bets on Fed hikes before the 27-28 October meeting, and margin calls from a tech stock selloff added to selling.
